notes: Stories already complete and properly decomposed; minor evidence refinement applied.

change_log.note: Expanded evidence to include both domain services used by facade

stories.title: Define Evaluate Care Facade Request/Response Schema
stories.description: Unified request/response contract with explicit operation enum, normalized inputs, shared response envelope (status, data, errors, metadata), and forward-compatible extension fields.

stories.title: Implement Facade Orchestration Logic
stories.description: Deterministic routing, aggregation, normalization, and error standardization across clinical_trials_service and provider_detail_service with consistent envelope output and graceful degradation.

stories.title: Expose Evaluate Care Facade via Tool Router Interface
stories.description: Expose facade via tool_router with strict Pydantic validation, operation dispatch, and compatibility with Anthropic tool-use loop and allowlist enforcement (GOV-004).

stories.title: Integration with Domain Services
stories.description: End-to-end validation of data flow between facade and domain services including transformation accuracy, schema conformity, and handling of partial or inconsistent upstream data.

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Facade Orchestration
stories.description: Comprehensive unit and integration tests covering schema contract, routing logic, error handling, and full tool_router flows for both trials search and provider detail.
